newsItems.title: OpenAI says California should strengthen its AI safety bill
newsItems.summary: OpenAI is calling for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill that the company previously opposed.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 基础模型能力、价格和开放策略的变化，会迅速传导到整个应用生态。
newsItems.titleZh: OpenAI 表示加州应加强人工智能安全法案
newsItems.summaryZh: OpenAI 呼吁加州加强 SB 53，这是该公司之前反对的人工智能安全法案。

newsItems.title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
newsItems.summary: A new study finds leading AI labs have few publicly documented plans for containing rogue models, raising questions about preparedness as AI systems increasingly demonstrate unexpected and potentially dangerous behavior.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 基础模型能力、价格和开放策略的变化，会迅速传导到整个应用生态。
newsItems.titleZh: Frontier AI 实验室仍然不愿透露他们如何遏制流氓模型
newsItems.summaryZh: 一项新的研究发现，领先的人工智能实验室几乎没有公开记录的遏制流氓模型的计划，随着人工智能系统越来越多地表现出意外和潜在危险的行为，引发了有关准备工作的问题。
